unDef.description: The result of evaluating a ‹parenthesized path pattern expression› that specifies an ‹any path search› or a ‹counted shortest path search›.
Which additional path bindings are actually probed to establish whether they might also raise an exception when the GQL-implementation has terminated the evaluation of a selective path pattern.
The order of properties in the expansion of an ‹all properties reference›.

The order of considering candidate solutions to a selective ‹path pattern› and, even if an SQL-implementation defines that it stops the evaluation of a selective ‹path pattern› on an exception, whether a candidate solution that would raise an exception if actually tested.
The value of ‹graphical match number function›.

The value returned by the ‹element_id function› that encapsulates the identity of a graph element in the SQL-property graph that contains the graph element for the duration of the current transaction.
If ‹graph table derived table› does not specify a ‹correlation name›, then the implicit ‹correlation name›.
The column aliases that are generated for ‹graph table derived table› if EXPORT NO SINGLETONS is not specified explicitly or implicitly.
The match number assigned to a match.
The identifier that is unique within the pure property graph and assigned to each vertex.
The identifier that is unique within the pure property graph and assigned to each edge.
The implicit identifiers required in path pattern evaluation.

The value of DEFINED_LABEL_SET_IDENTIFIER that uniquely identifies the defined label set being described among all defined label sets of the SQL-property graph identified by PROPERTY_GRAPH_CATALOG, PROPERTY_GRAPH_SCHEMA, and PROPERTY_GRAPH_NAME.
